about_the_game:
Breakout remake with a tempest 2000 and Geometry Wars like twist. No in-game purchase everything is included. The ultimate survival mode with Infinite looping levels, getting progressively harder on each loop. Submit you high scores and race to be the global leader.

--Features --

No in-game purchases, you get the full game from the start.

Arcare Mode

Infinite Game Mode.

Level Select Game Mode.

Global high score board, stored remotely.

Steam Leaderboards for each mode

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or newer, Arch, Debian 12 "Bookworm" or newer.
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ or Vulkan-capable, Nvidia and AMD GPUs, 1Gb Vram
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Gnome desktop environment running on top of X11 or Wayland windowing system, Nvidia official proprietary graphics driver, or AMD Mesa graphics driver. Other configuration and user environment as provided stock with the supported distribution (Kernel, Compositor, etc.) Notes: • Ubuntu 22.04: Wayland is supported with AMD graphics cards. • Ubuntu 24.04: Wayland is supported with AMD graphics cards and Nvidia graphics cards utilizing Nvidia proprietary graphics drivers 550 and above.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or newer, Arch, Debian 12 "Bookworm" or newer.
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ or Vulkan-capable, Nvidia and AMD GPUs, 2Gb Vram
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Gnome desktop environment running on top of X11 or Wayland windowing system, Nvidia official proprietary graphics driver, or AMD Mesa graphics driver. Other configuration and user environment as provided stock with the supported distribution (Kernel, Compositor, etc.) Notes: • Ubuntu 22.04: Wayland is supported with AMD graphics cards. • Ubuntu 24.04: Wayland is supported with AMD graphics cards and Nvidia graphics cards utilizing Nvidia proprietary graphics drivers 550 and above.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Greater
  • Processor: 3.0 Ghz X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs, 1Gb Vram
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer (X64), Windows 11 21H2 (build 22000) or newer (Arm64)
